extracted.name: Spicy Fry Sauce
extracted.description: This easy spicy fry sauce is a heat-infused twist on the standard ketchup and mayo mixture, which is a must-have in Utah with crispy, hot French fries.
instruction_lines: Stir together mayonnaise and ketchup in a small bowl until well combined; season with onion powder, cayenne, black pepper, and salt.
